input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I haven’t been able to send those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called—for the past few hours. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?

I just checked, and it looks like my phone isn’t showing any signal at the top, and it says data is disabled. I’m also not able to send picture messages at all right now—there’s no error message, it just doesn’t go through.

I’m not sure about regular calls or texts at the moment. What should I do next?
My phone says there’s no SIM card detected. I don’t see any messages about Airplane Mode being on, just that there’s no SIM. What should I do now?

Alright, I’ve reinserted the SIM card as you described. Now my phone shows a strong signal at the top, and it looks like mobile data is enabled again. What should I do next to see if I can send picture messages?
I just tried to send a picture message, but it still won’t go through. There’s no error message, it just doesn’t send. Is there something else I should try? This is getting a bit frustrating.

I checked, and my phone says the APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." I’m not really sure what any of that means. Should I still reset the APN settings, or do you see anything wrong with what I have? I get nervous about changing things I don’t understand.

Alright, I went ahead and reset the APN settings like you suggested. You mentioned I need to restart my phone now—will that erase any of my photos or messages? I’m a bit worried about losing anything important.

My phone has restarted and everything seems to be back to normal, but I still can’t send picture messages. It just won’t go through. Is there anything else we can try? I’m starting to get a bit anxious about this.
I checked, and Wi-Fi Calling is already turned off on my phone. What should I do next? Do you want me to check the messaging app permissions now?

I checked the permissions for my messaging app, and it looks like it only has permission for “phone.” I don’t see storage or SMS permissions enabled. Should I turn those on? If so, can you walk me through how to do that?

I’ve turned on both the storage and SMS permissions for my messaging app, but I still can’t send picture messages. It just won’t go through. Is there anything else we can try? I’m really hoping to get this working soon.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

Since your phone says there’s no SIM card detected, the most common fix is to reseat the SIM card. This means removing the SIM card from your phone and then reinserting it to ensure it’s properly connected.

Please follow these steps:
1. Power off your phone.
2. Remove the SIM card tray and take out the SIM card.
3. Wait a few seconds, then carefully reinsert the SIM card into the tray.
4. Put the tray back into your phone and power it on.
